reason: The automatic detection and restore for moved or trashed folders resolves my main fear about Google Drive safety, while the statutory blueprints give me the immutable maker-checker sign-off trail I desperately need for peer reviews. At ₹12,990 per year with the 30-day guarantee, it is well worth securing before the next ROC filing rush.
objection: Even with cloud metadata sync, my main worry is whether folder re-linking is truly instantaneous if an article clerk deletes a client folder at 10 PM right on a filing deadline.
